summary_note: Descriptions and skills are plain-language summaries of the official NOC main duties. Employment requirements below were copied from the official English profiles on 2026-11-07. The linked profile is the source if a posting disagrees.
promise_note: Saving a role does not submit an application, enroll you in a course, or promise a job, a visa, a licence, or that you meet an employer's requirements.
exclusions: Farm and agricultural employers and duties, including farm office work
Food production and processing, including NOC 95106
Domestic work, house helpers, and caregivers
exclusion_note: These exclusions stay in force even when a selected NOC's official index lists a similar title. Match a future posting by its NOC 2021 code, then read the duties. An alias is only a hint when the posting has no code. An exact title match is not required, and a title match alone is not enough.
forklift_note: CCOHS says forklift trucks should be operated only by experienced workers who are trained, certified, or licensed, and that some jurisdictions allow only a competent or authorized operator. The same page says CSA standard B335-15 (R2020) covers operator training. Rules differ by province. None of the online courses here is a forklift licence or a hands-on evaluation.
licence_note: Where a posting requires a driver's licence, that means a licence accepted for that province and that work. This tracker does not record or confirm any licence you hold.

employment_requirements: Completion of a college or other program in computer science, network administration, Web technology or a related field is usually required.

roles.informal_fr_note: Informal French label, not the official French NOC title.
roles.description: Coordinate retail staff and shifts, handle returns and complaints, maintain stock, and train staff.
employment_requirements: Completion of secondary school is usually required.
Previous retail sales experience as a retail salesperson or sales clerk, cashier, telemarketer, door-to-door salesperson or rental agent is usually required.
roles.requirements_note: Quoted from the official NOC 2021 employment-requirements section on 2026-11-07. The telemarketer and door-to-door wording is part of that official sentence. Those duties are still excluded from future searches for this tracker.
roles.screening_warning: The official profile also covers bakery, delicatessen, meat-department, and food-store supervision, door-to-door sales, and telemarketing, and its duties include developing marketing strategies. employment_requirements: Completion of secondary school is usually required.
Experience in a related clerical occupation or as a warehouse worker may be required.
A forklift certificate may be required.
A driver's licence may be required.
roles.requirements_note: Quoted from the official NOC 2021 employment-requirements section on 2026-11-07. A forklift certificate or driver's licence, when an employer requires one, is separate from the optional online courses below. See the forklift and licence notes.
roles.screening_warning: The official title index includes food and beverage processing and produce shipping, for example milk and cream receiver and produce shipper. Food production, fish processing, farm work, and restaurant work stay excluded even if the posting uses this NOC.

roles.informal_fr_note: Informal French label, not the official French NOC title.
roles.description: Move, load, unload, sort, and pack materials by hand or with handling equipment in warehouses, storage, and transport.
skills: Safe equipment use when trained and authorized
employment_requirements: Some secondary school education may be required.
Physical strength is required for manual material handlers who work with heavy materials.
roles.requirements_note: Quoted from the official NOC 2021 employment-requirements section on 2026-11-07. The official index also lists forklift operators and grain-elevator work. Those are not entry-level aliases, and the online courses here do not grant them.
roles.screening_warning: Do not treat agricultural, grain, farm, food-production, or fish-plant employers as matches only because this NOC is broad. Forklift operator is an official example title, not a synonym for an applicant without forklift training. Grain elevator operator is an official inclusion and stays outside the farm and food exclusions.

roles.requirements_note: Quoted from the official NOC 2021 employment-requirements section on 2026-11-07. The official duties also say some workers may operate forklifts or other powered industrial trucks. That is employer equipment training, not something these online courses grant.
